examples.trans: There is no compromising material on him at all. Just an ordinary guy.

examples.text: Это был обычный день.
examples.trans: It was an ordinary day.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'according to', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Стоп, почему посторонний в кадре?
examples.trans: Cut, why is an unauthorized person in the shot?

examples.text: Уберите руки, что вы себе позволяете?
examples.trans: Take your hands off, what do you think you are doing?

examples.text: Иди, видишь, искусство поднимаем.
examples.trans: Go on, you see we are elevating art.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'pocket / budget' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Витя, что за карма у тебя?
examples.trans: Vitya, what kind of karma do you have?

examples.text: И людям обычным по карману.
examples.trans: And affordable for ordinary people.

examples.text: Когда нет в кармане денег.
examples.trans: When there is no money in your pocket.
